stem.text: Read lines 14 to 15. Where did the Mole find himself when his snout came out into the sunlight?

carriers.key: Rolling in the warm grass of a great meadow.

options.value: On the bank of the river.
At the gap in the hedge.
In a boat painted blue and white.
options.execution: The blue and white boat at line 60 is the most vivid image in the passage and the one a reader carries away; it is pulled back here for that reason and no other.

options.value: Rolling in the warm grass of a great meadow.

stem.text: Read lines 29 to 33. What had the Mole never seen before in all his life?

options.value: An animal that chased and chuckled.

options.execution: The sunlight at line 14 is the passage's brightest image and is chosen for its vividness; he has seen the sun all through the meadow.
